scenario_definition.oracle_query: Find an existing commercial unit to assess a conversion into a play space / baby parking (hourly childcare) for 15 children, subject to confirmation of the applicable authorization regime in Turin with at least 115 sqm of gross floor area in energy class D or better near parks.

clarifications.I: I am looking for an existing commercial unit.
clarifications.D: I intend to assess a conversion into a play space / baby parking (hourly childcare), subject to confirmation of the applicable authorization regime.
clarifications.Cb: I need a property with at least 115 sqm of gross floor area and capacity for 15 people.
clarifications.Ce: I prefer a property in energy class D or better.

requirements.description: User prefers a property in energy class D or better, so classes A1 through D are included. The 'existing commercial unit' request does not map to any available column and adds no filter.

output.sql: SELECT * FROM ESTATES WHERE energy_class IN ('A1', 'A2', 'A3', 'A4', 'B', 'C', 'D') ORDER BY id ASC
output.explanation: Filters energy_class to D or better (A1-A4, B, C, D), which is a column present in both the runtime schema and filterable_columns. The requirement on tipologia_bene_immobile (commercial activities) was not applied because that column is not in filterable_columns; the equivalent filterable field is property_type, but it was not requested by the extracted requirements. No location was supplied, so results are ordered by id ascending.
